note: Review-build front matter (Chapter 1 stage). The full front matter (weightage chart, trends, changes to watch, diagnostic test) is generated after all chapters are built.

blocks.text: Every chapter follows the same route. Use this five-step routine for each topic:

items: **1. Understand:** read the blue UNDERSTAND IT box. It follows the ICAI study material heading by heading; nothing is left out.
**2. Lock the words:** read the ICAI KEYWORDS and MEMORY TRICK boxes. ICAI's suggested answers reuse study-material phrases, and marks go to those phrases.
**3. Attempt before reading:** cover the answer part of every OFFICIAL ICAI QUESTION (past paper, RTP, MTP) and write your answer first.
**4. Practise:** do the practice MCQs and expected questions, then the integrated cases and chapter test at the end of the chapter.
**5. Revise:** use the recall tests, the 5/15/30/60-minute revision ladder and the one-page sheet.

blocks.title: Reading the question labels
bullets: **PYQ May 2025 · Q4(a)** = ICAI exam paper, May 2025, question 4(a). In past papers Q1–Q4 are Financial Management and Q5–Q8 are Strategic Management; MCQ 1–8 are FM and MCQ 9–16 are SM.
**RTP Sep 2024 · FM Q12(a)** = ICAI Revision Test Paper for September 2024, FM section, question 12(a).
**MTP May 2026 Series I · SM Q2(a)** = ICAI Mock Test Paper for May 2026, Series I, SM section, question 2(a). **SM MCQ 1(A)(i)** = case-scenario MCQ (i) in Part I.
**FM Ch 1 §7.1** = Financial Management Chapter 1, study-material heading 7.1; **SM Ch 1 §1.5.2** = Strategic Management Chapter 1, heading 1.5.2.

blocks.title: Study guidance, not ICAI rules
bullets: Time guides, answer lengths, mark splits and memory tricks are study guidance written for this book, not ICAI rules.
ICAI questions are presented in our own words, with answers based on ICAI's suggested answers. Practice questions, cases and MCQs are written for this book on ICAI study-material topics.
ICAI has not published examiners' comments for Paper 6 (the Group II comments cover Papers 4 and 5), so no examiner comment is quoted in this book.

sections.heading: Exam at a Glance — Paper 6: FM & SM

blocks.text: Pattern verified from ICAI's question papers and suggested answers for Sep 2024 to May 2026 (100 marks, 3 hours):

rows: 15 marks: one case scenario with 5 MCQs × 2 marks, plus 2 independent MCQs × 2 marks and 1 MCQ × 1 mark
35 marks: Q1 compulsory (15 marks, 5 + 5 + 5); attempt any two of Q2–Q4 (10 marks each)
15 marks: one case scenario with 5 MCQs × 2 marks, plus 2 independent MCQs × 2 marks and 1 MCQ × 1 mark
35 marks: Q5 compulsory (15 marks, 5 + 5 + 5); attempt any two of Q6–Q8 (10 marks each)

blocks.title: Time per mark (study guidance)
bullets: 180 minutes ÷ 100 marks ≈ 1.8 minutes per mark. Keep about 10 minutes for reading the paper.
A 2-mark theory part ≈ 3–4 minutes; a 4-mark part ≈ 7 minutes; a 5-mark SM part ≈ 9 minutes.
FM Q4 is always theory (4 + 4 + 2 with an OR in part c); FM Chapter 1 and FM Chapter 2 supply most of it.
